TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian travellers aged 22-32 planning a first or repeat Mumbai Ganesh Chaturthi visit with a friend, overwhelmed by deciding dates, pandals and a workable day plan.
PRODUCT_FOCUS: Using Travafa's AI trip planner to organise a Mumbai Ganesh Chaturthi visit into an editable day-by-day trip plan.
KNOWN_PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES: Describe a destination, dates and preferences in a chat to receive an AI-generated day-by-day itinerary
Propose and vote on activities and destinations with a group
Search and book flights, hotels and activities inside a trip
Attach flights, hotels and activities to a trip plan
Use shared trip checklists, chat and documents
CREATIVE_ANGLE: Two friends have saved Mumbai Ganesh Chaturthi reels but still cannot decide which darshan days to visit or how to make a plan that works. One opens Travafa and starts a day-by-day Mumbai trip plan, turning uncertainty into a clear starting point.
LOOK_CONSTRAINTS: 9:16 authentic phone-shot UGC; soft early-morning monsoon daylight from camera-left; contemporary Mumbai apartment dining nook; muted mint and warm-neutral palette; the same South Indian woman in a cream linen shirt throughout; one friend present; all key action in the central 66% safe area.
